problem: MOOC records contain heterogeneous learner behavior and an imbalanced certification outcome, requiring separate governed analyses rather than one feature set for every task.
objectives: Describe the data, discover behavior-based student segments, test a non-linear representation, predict certification in a separate supervised track, and produce grounded bilingual explanations without leaking outcomes into clustering.
desired_outcomes: Auditable clean data, defensible student segments, an evaluated certification model, grounded explanation artifacts, deployment artifacts, and an honest monitoring baseline.
unit_of_analysis: Exactly one record per student (userid_DI), synthesized across all enrolled courses.
task_type: Multi-track: unsupervised clustering, deep representation learning, supervised classification, and grounded LLM-supported communication

constraints.strict_outcome_quarantine: Variables reflecting course completion or achievement (certified, grade, viewed, explored, incomplete_flag) are strictly quarantined at ingestion. Zero leakage into feature construction, representation learning, candidate selection, tuning, or model locking.
constraints.behavior_only_assignment: Age, gender, and education are excluded from every clustering representation and retained only for post-hoc subgroup diagnostics.
constraints.ethical_boundaries: Discovered segments must represent observed engagement patterns and support needs, never deficit-based student labeling or automated punitive sorting.
constraints.computational_efficiency: Feasible memory and runtime footprint allowing scalable inference across hundreds of thousands of learners.

success_criteria.internal_clustering_quality: Compare candidates using Silhouette, Davies-Bouldin, Calinski-Harabasz, and resample ARI on unseen evaluation data.
success_criteria.cluster_balance: All requested clusters must be populated and the selected solution must avoid negligible clusters.
success_criteria.reproducibility: Deterministic training pipelines with documented random seeds and cryptographic artifact checksums.
success_criteria.robustness: Measure assignment stability across repeated fits using Adjusted Rand Index.
success_criteria.fairness_sensitivity: Report demographic association diagnostics without treating them as proof of fairness.
success_criteria.post_hoc_relevance: After model lock, report outcome associations and effect sizes descriptively; do not use them as an optimization or pass/fail gate.

analysis_tracks: Track 1: Traditional Unsupervised on data-selected course-adjusted behavioral features
Track 2: Deep Learning classification with Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) architectures to predict certification
Track 3: Supervised certification classification with a separately governed target
Track 4: Generative LLM-supported communication using computed artifacts as grounding evidence
